verdict.rationale: Proa documents its own editor tools that add Rust completion, hover, go-to-definition, rename and semantic highlighting inside raw-string `md!`/`md_sync!` templates. It also documents cross-view diagnostics that flag a missing field in a paired Markdown view even when that file is not open, and compile-time template validation supports accurate errors. missing for 10: explicit coverage of HTML templates and other surfaces beyond `md!` macros, detail on the language-server mechanism and supported editors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
